newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING--China Southern Airlines Co Ltd.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING--China Southern Airlines Co Ltd.

text.p: China Southern Airlines Co Ltd filed Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission an initial public offering for up to 20.6 million American Depositary Shares, or 1,030,000,000 Ordinary H Shares.

In the filing, the company said the global offering consists of 7,070,260 ADSs in the United States and Canada, an offering of 11,465,740 ADSs outside the United States, Canada and China, and an offer for subscription of 71,000,000 H shares in Hong Kong.

After the global offering, 68.1 percent of the company's issued shares will be owned indirectly by the Chinese government, which will be entitled to elect all of the directors of the company and to control the management and policies of the company, China Southern said.
The initial public offering price is estimated to be between $24.20 and $30.65 per ADS.
The global coordinator is Goldman Sachs (Asia) LLC. The offering will be made through Goldman, Sachs & Co, Credit Suisse First Boston, PaineWebber Inc and Smith Barney Inc.
The company has granted U.S. and international underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to 3,090,000 additional ADSs, representing 154,500,000 H Shares.

Net proceeds will be used to make payments in respect of the acquisition of new aircraft and related flight equipment. The balance will be used to repay outstanding debt and to finance investments in other facilities and technology and working capital requirements.
China Southern has applied to the New York Stock Exchange to trade ADSs under the stock symbol ZNH ZNH.N and plans to list the H Shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
China Southern, based in Guangzhou, provides commercial airline service throughout China, Southeast Asia and other parts of the world.
